title: Italian Beef Pilaf
description: A hearty, comforting pilaf dish filled with tender beef and a blend of Italian seasonings.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the dried Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the Ukrainian pilaf and stir to combine with the beef mixture.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the pilaf is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
